authorityComparison.method: The locked vendored artifacts are verified byte-for-byte against the published authority CDN recorded in vendor.lock.json, and the committed op bundle is identified by SHA-256.

compatDeclaration.note: At this commit the declaration is narrowed to the tested authority scope: compat.mode "list" with the explicit 209 effect IDs the recorded rendered parity qualifies (210 catalog ids minus the compile-only filter/octaveWarp; the three GAP-007 overlay effects are settled at zero mismatched channels). tools/compat-gate.mjs rejects any declaration claiming more before delivery, with negative identity controls in test/compat-gate.test.js. The scaffold export-kit builder and its consuming host remain outside this repository; the served kit's compat.json must still be verified against this declaration at the published source SHA before GAP-006 closes.
